description.value: Chameleon is a sit-down restaurant in Maple Ridge offering lunch, brunch, happy hour, and dinner menus with an emphasis on fresh, local ingredients. The restaurant features a second-floor private dining room with AV equipment and can accommodate full buyouts for up to 75 guests, making it a versatile venue for both casual meals and special events. Touring cyclists will find a full-service dine-in option with an extensive wine, craft cocktail, and mocktail list in the heart of Maple Ridge.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 16m; stands (5 spaces) at 25m; rack at 82m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Chameleon is an operating full-service restaurant at 11965 224 Street, Maple Ridge, BC, with phone 604-467-5664 corroborating the OSM address. The 'Order Online' navigation link is positive evidence for takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving those criteria unconfirmable; additionally, the /contact subpage displays hours that contradict the footer widget shown on all other pages.
concerns: Hours discrepancy on the website: the /contact subpage header lists Monday and Tuesday as closed with daytime hours (Wed–Thu 12pm–9pm, Fri 12pm–10pm, Sat–Sun 11am–10/9pm), while the footer widget on every page shows Mon–Sun from 3pm onward. The two sets of hours cannot both be current.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-467-5664 was sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Chameleon is a clearly operating full-service restaurant and a plausible cyclist meal stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from website content. A brief follow-up or site visit is needed to confirm minimum criteria before including.
